note: Policies drafted from published coverage documents: Medicare LCDs and NCDs and public state Medicaid criteria. Each passes the drafting gates against its source (internal/draft/library_test.go). None is in force until a clinician signs it off: vaglio signoff, then copy it into the server's policy directory. The AHIP/BCBSA standard documentation set for 66 services is not public (only its categories are), so the library is built from public documents; categories are named after AHIP's where they match.
